policy: Every asset used in a video must be listed here with source and licence. No player photographs, broadcast footage, team/competition logos or third-party music without documented rights.

font-inter.notes: Subset to Latin + Greek, converted to WOFF2 (allowed by OFL).

music-bed-generated.source: Generated in code by src/render/audio.mjs (ffmpeg aevalsrc synthesis)
music-bed-generated.license: Original work of the project, no third-party rights
music-bed-generated.notes: No samples or recordings are used.

graphics-generated.source: Drawn in code by src/templates/page.mjs (HTML/CSS/SVG): charts, court lines, typography
graphics-generated.notes: Team colours are used as plain colour swatches; no logos or crests.
